title: SkillFrontmatter
description: Validation schema for Antigravity SKILL.md YAML frontmatter metadata

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier matching its parent directory name

description.description: Clear, informative summary of the skill capabilities and when to invoke it

tags.description: Keywords used for deterministic matching against user prompts

priority.description: Tie-breaking priority when multiple skills match the prompt

conflicts_with.description: List of skill names that cannot be co-activated with this skill

requires.description: List of prerequisite skill names required when this skill is active
